songs.title: Razorwire Run
songs.description: A new angular celesta hook skips over a warm sliding 808. Short brass responses, muted guitar ticks and a snappy TR-808 clap keep the route moving without a four-on-the-floor pattern.
songs.development: Immediate eight-bar hook; a clipped verse variation gives brass room, then a new rising bell B section turns through G minor and E-flat. An altered 808 pattern carries the groove switch before the high final hook.

Brass: compact two-note calls
Muted guitar: offbeat ticks
Warm custom 808: continuous pitch slides, not GM pitch jumps
TR-808 kit: half-time clap, broken kicks and selective triplet hat rolls

songs.title: Chrome Pressure
songs.description: New staccato strings strike a tight F-minor figure above gritty 808 locks and a sharp power-kit snare. Brass answers and orchestral hits mark the turns while the B melody broadens into a chase fanfare.
songs.development: A repeated-note string hook alternates clipped and leaping responses. Its new brass B section rises through D-flat, B-flat minor and E-flat; the groove switch keeps the backbeat while displacing the kick/808 attacks.

Brass: new eight-bar B melody
Orchestral hits and bright piano: selective join accents
Grit custom 808: restrained distortion and real rising/falling slides
Power kit: half-time snare, offset kicks, short hat bursts and low tom joins

songs.title: Jade Circuit
songs.description: A nimble new F-sharp-minor flute tune rides clean sliding low end. Koto plucks answer from the opposite side, with small electric-piano voicings and a light, sharply articulated TR-808 kit.
songs.development: The flute hook turns between an ascending question and a lower answer. Its new B melody adds a bright D-major contour, then winds through B minor and C-sharp dominant; a syncopated groove switch keeps the tune moving.

Koto: clear plucked answers
Electric piano and clean guitar: small harmonic flashes
Clean custom 808: longer connected gates and soft continuous pitch glides
TR-808 kit: single half-time clap, rim ghosts and selective triplet hats

songs.development: Clavinet and brass alternate eight-bar calls. A newly written electric-piano B melody crosses C-major and A-minor colors, then a displaced bounce pattern sets up the final higher clavinet statement.

songs.title: Glassfang Sprint
songs.style: Glassy dark-crystal melodic trap with gritty 808 locks
songs.description: A sharply etched crystal hook starts immediately above a distorted but tuned 808. Koto pickups and muted-guitar chord chips keep the foreground crisp, while sparse choir colors frame a wider B melody. Listen for short upper-neighbor bass scoops and the final eighth-bar hat rolls.
songs.development: 48 bars: crystal A1–8, thinner koto-answer verse9–16, expanded A17–24, rising B25–32, displaced-kick groove33–40, and octave-answered final A41–48. A new flute-led B lifts the register without slowing the pulse.
